title: Global Dollar (USDG) on Aave Arbitrum Assessments
body: This thread is the home for all risk and technical assessments of USDG on Aave Arbitrum. It collects, in one place: The pre-listing asset risk assessment, under the Aave Risk Framework. The pre-listing technical asset assessment, under the Technical Asset Listing Framework. All post-listing monitoring reports, periodic refresh assessments, and any re-evaluations triggered by material changes. For the first parameter recommendation, see our reply on the listing proposal . New assessments and updates will be posted as replies below as they are produced, so the full history stays in a single thread.
